summary: Backend-only verification of Super Admin Gym Management + Forgot/Reset Password. Wrote pytest suite (14 tests) hitting the external preview URL through the FastAPI->Next proxy. All 14 pass on final run. Verified: SUPER_ADMIN login (httpOnly gymos_session), GET /api/admin/gyms, POST /api/admin/gyms creating gym+GYM_ADMIN atomically with no passwordHash leaked, new admin can log in, duplicate admin email -> 409 with no orphan gym, GET/PATCH by id, invalid id -> 404, status PATCH suspends+reactivates without deleting business data, GYM_ADMIN -> 403 and unauth -> 401 on /api/admin/gyms, forgot-password returns generic 200 for existing AND non-existent emails with identical body and no raw token, weak password -> 422, garbage token -> 400, valid reset -> {success:true}, token single-use (reuse -> 400), old session invalidated (/me -> 401) after reset, fresh login with new password works. Demo Gym Admin password restored to GymAdmin@123.

minor.issue: Sub-second race in session-invalidation check. JWT `iat` is stored in seconds (jose setIssuedAt) but user.passwordChangedAt is stored in ms. In src/lib/auth/session.ts the guard is `payload.iat * 1000 < new Date(user.passwordChangedAt).getTime()`. If a client logs in within the same wall-clock second as the reset (e.g., <=1s later), `iat*1000` equals floor(now/1000)*1000 which is < passwordChangedAt(ms), so the just-issued fresh session is spuriously rejected and /api/auth/me returns 401. Repro: reset password, then immediately login and call /me within ~1s -> 401. Workaround in test: sleep 1.5s. Fix suggestion: compare in seconds granularity, e.g. `payload.iat < Math.floor(new Date(user.passwordChangedAt).getTime()/1000)`, or subtract 1000ms of tolerance.

action_items: Fix sub-second session-invalidation race in src/lib/auth/session.ts by comparing iat vs passwordChangedAt at second-level granularity (or add ~1s tolerance).
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/auth/session.ts session-invalidation compares seconds*1000 against ms directly; add second-level rounding to avoid rejecting freshly minted tokens issued in the same wall-clock second as a password change.

Consider returning a stable, well-defined JSON shape (e.g., {gym:{...}}) uniformly from GET /api/admin/gyms/{id} and PATCH endpoints - current tests handled both {gym:...} and raw gym shapes defensively.

rca of the issue: Session-invalidation timing bug: JWT iat granularity (seconds) mismatches passwordChangedAt granularity (ms). When both events occur in the same wall-clock second, iat*1000 < passwordChangedAt_ms is true, so the fresh session token is treated as pre-change and rejected. Deterministic when reset->login gap < ~1s; disappears once the second boundary is crossed. Fix by comparing at second granularity: `payload.iat < Math.floor(passwordChangedAt.getTime()/1000)` (strictly less-than after flooring), which is the intended semantic.
